issues.where: §2 Why green and magenta; Block A MANNEQUIN RULE; §3 setup; §7 Step 1; Checklist line 2
issues.problem: The whole method assumes ChatGPT keeps the attached mannequin 'exactly as it is', so each piece comes out 'already in the right place'. GPT-4o and gpt-image never keep pixels. Every reply repaints the whole picture, so the mannequin comes back moved or resized by a few pixels, with new shading and slightly different magenta and green. If Saleh asks ChatGPT to fix a detail in its last image, it repaints everything again and the drift adds up. Nothing in the brief tells him not to do this. The checklist also asks him to confirm the mannequin is 'untouched', which he can't judge by eye. 6.1 asks for exact pixel landmarks (y=260 and y=424), which ChatGPT can't measure. If the base figure comes out too big, every later tall hat (qalansuwa, tartur, top hat) runs out of headroom.
